recs.stt: Dwarf Fortress: Ten hours with the most inscrutable video game of all time
recs.x:
I recommend everyone watch the following video to learn about how the actual gameplay works:

 [link]

It's a wall with electrified spikes on top. And armed guards instructed to shoot on sight. And rabid dogs. And behind the wall there are other walls.

I tried to start the game 5 times. The first 3 I could not even start a game. The 4th one I followed a tutorial and was able to start, and nothing else. The fifth time, I found Captnduck's excellent video tutorials ( [link] ), and I was finally able to break into the game.
